_documentation.purpose: Bulk import customers into BazaarPrinting CRM. Generate a JSON file matching this schema exactly.
_documentation.audience: AI assistants or scripts converting data from spreadsheets or other CRMs.
_documentation.output_format: Single JSON object. Root must include a customers array. Keys starting with _ are documentation only — ignored on import.
instructions: Return valid JSON only — no markdown fences, no commentary outside the JSON.
Put one object per customer in the customers array (max 500).
Every customer MUST include: first_name, phone.
For industry: copy the value slug from _lookups (e.g. cannabis_cbd) — NEVER use the human label (e.g. Cannabis & CBD). If unknown, omit — defaults to 'other'.
phone: digits only or formatted — at least 10 digits after stripping non-digits. Leading country code 1 on 11-digit numbers is stripped automatically.
authority: yes | no (or omit — defaults to 'yes').
customer_since: the date this customer was first created in the source system (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Used as created_at — preserves real customer history. Omit if unknown.
Replace the example customer with all real rows. Delete the _note key.

optional.industry: string — value slug from _lookups.industry (example: cannabis_cbd). Defaults to 'other' if omitted.
optional.authority: yes | no — defaults to 'yes' if omitted
optional.customer_since: ISO 8601 date — when the customer was first created in the source system. Stored as created_at.

_lookups.how_to_use: Pick industry from value column. Download template from Admin page to get your live database list.

imported_by_note: REPLACE — short batch note for staff (e.g. Migrated from InkCloud Jun 2026)

customers._note: DELETE this key — example only. One customer shown; add more objects to this array.
